policy: All surviving and uncovered mutants remain in the raw report and denominator. Classifications explain remaining evidence limits; no mutator exclusions or score adjustments are applied.

A valid ModelResult.request passed to parseModelResult yields needs_input or throws. Removing this guard differs for an absent request outside that typed boundary, but still fails closed; no equivalence claim for malformed in-process objects.
The operation prefix is opaque within the dedicated review session. Removing it preserves the deterministic identity and remains within the identifier contract; the raw mutant is retained.
Keeping all 64 digest characters instead of 48 preserves deterministic operation identity and remains below the 100-character identifier limit. Exact hash truncation is not a product contract.
Removing the separator between multiple readiness diagnostics changes spacing, while each diagnostic and the admission rejection remain intact. No exact-wording equivalence is claimed.

The remote receipt comparison repeats the accompanying rendered-state fence in the exercised lifecycle states. It remains an explicit independent acknowledgment defense; tests do not manufacture an otherwise unreachable partial in-memory receipt.
